instruction: Help me freeze the range A1:B1 on this sheet to keep the headers always visible

candidates.name: Manage Calc Rows Columns Freeze and Split Views
candidates.description: Resize, hide, move, or freeze worksheet rows and columns and handle split or zoom-like view controls without mixing them into formatting-only tasks.

candidates.name: Build Merged Report Headers and Multi Row Layouts
candidates.description: Merge header ranges, handle hidden-cell warnings deliberately, and verify that multi-row report headers still span the intended block after the merge.

candidates.name: Insert and Format Tables
candidates.description: Insert a table, edit cells or headers while the table stays active, and verify the resulting structure on the slide canvas.

candidates.name: Sort and Filter Calc Tables
candidates.description: Apply sorts, auto-filters, and range filters to Calc tables and verify the visible filtered rows or ordering on the sheet.

candidates.name: Format Calc Cell Text Alignment and Borders
candidates.description: Apply direct cell formatting such as font weight, font size, alignment, fill, and borders, then verify that the requested style landed only on the intended range.

candidates.name: Highlight Weekend or Rule Matched Cells
candidates.description: Highlight cells or rows that match visible weekend or value rules when the end state is a directly visible on-sheet match result rather than a dialog-centric conditional-format authoring flow.

candidates.name: Fill Copy Paste and Split Calc Data
candidates.description: Copy, paste, fill down, duplicate rows, or split text into columns while protecting existing values and keeping the destination range aligned with the task.

candidates.name: Create Chart on Target Sheet with Exact Title and Type
candidates.description: Create a chart on the requested destination sheet while honoring an exact chart title and chart family.

candidates.name: Protect Calc Sheets and Allowed Actions
candidates.description: Protect worksheets, set passwords, and control allowed actions for protected sheets.

candidates.name: Insert Page Numbers, Headers, Footers, and Blank Pages
candidates.description: Enable page-style headers or footers, insert page numbers, add blank pages, and verify the structural result on the document canvas.
